Cookie Notice

October 21, 2026 · Español (privacidad)

We use cookies and similar technologies on https://desk.rekov.co and the authenticated dashboard to keep you signed in, remember preferences, measure product usage, and protect against abuse.

Types

  • Strictly necessary: session and security tokens required to operate the Service.
  • Functional: language or UI preferences where enabled.
  • Analytics: aggregated usage to improve performance (only if enabled).

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking necessary cookies may prevent login. For EEA/UK visitors, non-essential cookies are used only with consent where required by law.

See our Privacy Policy. Questions: privacy@rekov.co
